note: Drive-in north-shore campground at Eleven Mile Reservoir with its own boat ramp; Rocky Ridge is the park's electric campground. --Claude
summary: CPW camping page + cpwshop site data: sites 80 -> 79 (A 15, B 22, C 10, D 22, E 10), confirmed no electric and pull-throughs, added max 110 ft, year-round season (A Loop only in winter; B-E close Nov 1), url/window/fcfs never/14-night max/booking season. Fees ($28 basic) and facilities left as stored (vault toilets, hand pumps and the dump station are stated park-wide). Note: dropped the site-count/amenity/big-rig/booking restatements and 'Camp Colorado'.
flags: Split question: the evidence is mixed and points toward North Shore being its own campground along the shared north-shore park road (County Road 333): CPW names it separately, and its D/E loops sit ~1.3 km west of Rocky Ridge (2249), but its A-C loops are only ~250-600 m west of Rocky Ridge's A/B loops, each loop of both campgrounds being its own spur off the same county road from the main entrance. No change suggested.
Eleven Mile's other campgrounds: see the flag on 2254 - every drive-in one has an entry; only the Backcountry Walk-In tent area (not drive-in) has none.
Pin 38.9384,-105.5141 sits at the D/E loops, ~420 m from the 79-site centroid (38.9372,-105.5095); the loops span ~1.5 km, so within tolerance.
cpwshop shows North Shore A Loop site 201 not bookable on any date sampled (Oct 2026 - Apr 2027) while its neighbours 210 and 215 are; possibly a site out of service.
